messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 1795128600 - service error-rate elevated for inference-prod (>6% over 5m) :rotating_light:
Kai: Acknowledged. Oncall Kai taking lead. Spawning a debug session and checking pool metrics.
Priya: Seeing queue depth spikes on 'hot-pool-2' and memory pressure on worker nodes. A few OOM kills in last 7m.
Marco: Are these coming from a single customer or traffic-wide?
Priya: A small cohort of long-context streaming requests from prod-tenant-7 are dominating tails.
Tanya: I'm going to flip routing so tenant-7 goes to dedicated low-latency pool for now. Also enabling per-tenant concurrency cap.
Kai: Good. Priorities: reduce customer impact, suppress noisy alerts, and prepare post-incident tuning items.
Tanya: Routing change applied. Tenant-7 now routed to pool 'dedicated-tenant7' and concurrency limited to 6.
Marco: Deploy a short-lived throttle for long-context queries to avoid KV cache thrash. Push rate-limit 1 req/s for contexts > 2k tokens for that tenant.
Priya: Doing it now. Adding tag 'mitigation=throttle-2k' to requests so we can filter later.
OpsBot: Silence created: alert=per-instance-oom duration=3h created_by=Kai id=si-b2d9
Kai: We need to be careful with silences—only suppress noisy infra-level alerts. Keep higher-level customer-facing alerts active.
Priya: Metrics after routing change: error-rate dropped to ~2.2% in 3m for affected tenant. Global error-rate dipped to 1.8%. Latency p95 back to baseline for most services.
Marco: Next steps for post-incident cleanup: list of proposed alert changes and validation plan. I'll open OP-4309 and add owners.
Kai: Post-incident proposal summary (brief):
- alert: per-instance-oom -> keep, but change to require 2 occurrences in 10m before paging
- alert: worker-memory-spike -> change to warning, page only if sustained >15m
- alert: inference-error-rate -> keep at 5% but add exclusion tag 'maintenance' and 'batch-job'
- add new alert: kv-warmup-failure (warn only)
- create dashboard overlay comparing old vs new thresholds
Marco: I'll run a replay/test to validate thresholds against last 96h of traffic. Running: `opsctl replay --source traces --lookback 96h --policy alert-tune-v1`
Tanya: I'll add a maintenance window during the tuning rollout to prevent churn from expected restarts: MW mw-1001 for 4h, scope=hot-pool and canary rollouts.
OpsBot: Maintenance window created: id=mw-1001 created_by=Tanya duration=4h scope=hot-pool
Priya: Also proposing an automatic fallback tweak: if pool queue depth > 80 or error-rate > 4% for 2m, divert new requests to cheaper variant or return 429 fast-fail for non-critical SDK clients.
Kai: Agreement: do both. Fast-fail for best-effort clients and diversion for critical ones. Add labeling so we can measure dropped vs diverted.
Marco: Running replay finished. Summary: with proposed settings, pages would have dropped by ~78% during the major spikes, no customer-facing pages triggered in simulation. Saving the detailed report to OP-4309.
Priya: Dashboard changes made: new panel overlaying legacy thresholds vs proposed ones, and a filter for mitigation tags. Link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/alert-tuning?from=now-4h&to=now
Kai: I'll own verification: run the canary changes for 30m, then extend to 100% if stable.
Tanya: Creating a smoke alert for KV-warmup failures: low-noise, severity=warning only.
OpsBot: Silence audit: found 2 active silences older than 24h, listing in OP-4309.
Marco: After canary run (15m): error-rate in canary 1.1% and p95 latency improved 40%. No new OOMs in the canary nodes.
Kai: Hand-off: I'll remain on call for 45m to watch for regressions, then hand back to rotation. Please complete the following items before I sign off:
- Marco: attach replay artifacts and the simulation summary to OP-4309 (owner=Marco)
- Tanya: push alertmanager config changes to staging and create PR (owner=Tanya)
- Priya: tag mitigation traffic and prepare query set for regression detection (owner=Priya)
- Ops: run silence audit and expire unneeded silences (owner=Ops)
Marco: Done note in ticket and attached logs.
Tanya: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/alertmanager/pull/742. Includes changed thresholds and routing rules.
Priya: Mitigation tags applied. Query set stored at s3://redwood-ops/ops/alert-replay/tenant7-sample.json
CS-bot: CS notified of potential customer impact and draft message prepared for affected tenants.
Kai: Incident marked mitigated once global error-rate <5% for 10m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1795128600 marked MITIGATED at 1795128730 by Kai.
Kai: Final cleanup checklist before resolve: merge PR, run replay in staging, remove temporary silence after 2h if no regressions, and publish a short post-incident note to #incidents summarizing root cause and changes.
OpsBot: Silence si-b2d9 scheduled to expire at 1795139800 unless manually cleared.
Kai: All good so far. Posting final note to OP-4309 and will convert into a postmortem doc. Thanks team.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1795128600 RESOLVED at 1795128775 by Kai.
Kai: Great job everyone — follow-up owners assigned in OP-4309. :tada:
